original_acceptance: main/develop protections verified with rejected unauthorized push and executed CI
amended_acceptance: The private GitHub Free limitation for server-enforced main/develop protection is documented with the observed HTTP 403 response; remote rejection is not claimed.
Local source-policy checks, signed SHA-bound owner receipts, independent QC, deterministic serialized integration, ancestry checks and audit logging pass on the pinned source and integration SHAs.
The configured GitHub Actions workflows and available run evidence are recorded; hosted enforcement remains DEFERRED_PLAN and local tests are not represented as hosted CI.
Publication remains owner-authorized and fast-forward-only; main is not changed by this amendment.

owner_authorization.scope: Replace the GitHub Pro-dependent MIG-002 requirement with a versioned private-repository GitHub Free development-security baseline; do not purchase Pro, make the repository public, or weaken security controls.

acceptance_matrix.original_requirement: Server-enforced main/develop branch protection and rejected unauthorized push
acceptance_matrix.github_free_support: No for this private repository; the API returned HTTP 403 requiring Pro or public visibility.
acceptance_matrix.alternative: Deterministic local policy validation, one serialized Merger, fast-forward ancestry checks and owner-controlled publication.
acceptance_matrix.security_properties: One integration writer, protected main workflow, SHA-bound candidate and audit receipts.
acceptance_matrix.residual_risks: A remote actor with repository write access is not rejected by GitHub server-side rules.
acceptance_matrix.owner_acknowledgment: The owner accepts this documented residual risk for the private development baseline.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Run local policy, ancestry, Merger and negative isolated-repository tests.

acceptance_matrix.github_free_support: Workflow execution is available, but quota and plan limits prevent treating it as a protected gate here.
acceptance_matrix.alternative: Run deterministic local unit, integration, security and no-network Docker checks; record hosted-only checks as DEFERRED_PLAN.
acceptance_matrix.security_properties: A candidate cannot enter the Merger without bounded deterministic and independent QC evidence.
acceptance_matrix.residual_risks: Hosted runner drift is not covered by local execution.
acceptance_matrix.owner_acknowledgment: No local result is represented as hosted CI.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Record exact local commands, exit codes, artifact hashes and observed hosted run metadata.

acceptance_matrix.github_free_support: Repository-side rulesets are unavailable on the current private plan.
acceptance_matrix.alternative: Use signed SHA-bound owner receipts where required, independent QC and serialized Merger admission.
acceptance_matrix.security_properties: Candidate, base, source, test and reviewer evidence remain bound in SQLite.
acceptance_matrix.residual_risks: Local controls depend on the operator preserving the approved workflow.
acceptance_matrix.owner_acknowledgment: The local controls are supplementary and are not described as GitHub branch protection.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Inspect receipts, ancestry and rejected-candidate audit records.

acceptance_matrix.github_free_support: Fast-forward publication is available but is not a server-enforced review gate.
acceptance_matrix.alternative: Require explicit owner authorization, source-SHA verification and fast-forward-only publication tooling.
acceptance_matrix.security_properties: No force-push, no main rewrite and no publication without an authorized integration checkpoint.
acceptance_matrix.residual_risks: A manually bypassed local workflow could still publish if credentials permit it.
acceptance_matrix.owner_acknowledgment: Publication remains a separately authorized operation.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Use isolated negative tests and verify remote ancestry read-only before publication.

residual_risks: GitHub Free does not provide server-enforced branch protection for this private repository.
Hosted CI and runner-environment enforcement remain explicitly deferred where quota or plan policy prevents verification.
Local controls cannot technically prevent a separately authorized operator from bypassing them.
